scientific_integrity: Analytical proof supplies universal statements; a finite exact-arithmetic checker supplies independent computations at selected finite instances, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-spacing grids with fixed amplitude-and-slope sensors are optimized.
Information determinant uses independent identically distributed Gaussian observation errors with one fixed variance.
The asymptotic keeps the positive spectral offset-to-gap ratio fixed.
No general nonuniform-grid optimality or global priority is claimed.
title: A universal optimal observation horizon for arithmetic-spectrum flows
